literal_meaning: হাড়কে গুঁড়ো করে ফেলা (to grind bones into powder)
figurative_meaning_bn: চলনশক্তি রহিত করা, প্রচণ্ড প্রহার করা
figurative_meaning_en: To render immobile by beating severely, to thrash brutally
similar_in_english: Beat the living daylights out of someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: শত্রুরা তাকে হাড় গুঁড়ো করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The enemies beat him to a pulp.
The police thrashed the criminal brutally.
note: This idiom vividly describes extreme physical punishment, common in Bengali folklore and everyday speech.
